content.user_title: Profile Cloudflare Workers CPU and Memory
content.value_statement: CPU hotspots and memory allocation pressure can make deployed Workers and Durable Objects difficult to diagnose. This skill guides profiling, evidence analysis, and targeted optimization.
actual_capabilities: Guide confirmation of the account, Worker, environment, deployed version, and Durable Object identity before profiling.
Consult the current Cloudflare guide to select supported CPU or heap profiling types.
Guide profile capture using the cf CLI, with installed command help and schema checks where available.
Analyze pprof evidence for hotspots and map findings to functions and source locations when supported.
Recommend source maps for generated JavaScript and propose minimal changes with steps to check their effects.
limitations: This skill provides instructions, not a bundled profiler or executable implementation.
Profile capture requires access to the deployed target and suitable external tooling.
Supported profiling types and command syntax depend on current documentation and the installed CLI version.
Missing symbols or source maps can prevent attribution to original source locations.

use_cases.title: Investigate Worker CPU usage
use_cases.description: Inspect production CPU profiles, identify expensive functions, and propose a targeted change with a verification plan.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Durable Object memory growth
use_cases.description: Confirm the owning Worker, namespace, and instance before selecting an appropriate profile and examining memory evidence.

use_cases.title: Review optimization evidence
use_cases.description: Connect profiling metrics to source locations and evaluate whether a proposed code change addresses the observed hotspot.

prompt_templates.title: Begin a profiling investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me investigate high CPU usage in my deployed Cloudflare Worker. Ask for the account, environment, deployed version, and affected workload before proceeding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: establish the symptom and deployment target.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a CPU profile capture
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide CPU profile capture for [Worker] in [environment]. Consult current Cloudflare documentation and inspect installed cf help before recommending commands.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare capture using available tooling.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Durable Object memory evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my supplied Durable Object pprof capture for allocation pressure or memory growth. Confirm the target instance and report supported metrics and missing symbols.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: interpret a supplied memory profile.

prompt_templates.title: Propose an evidence-based optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my supplied profile and source for [Worker]. Identify supported hotspots, propose the smallest change, and explain how to check its effect.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: connect profiling evidence to a minimal code change.

output_examples.input: My Worker has high CPU usage, but I have not captured a profile.
output: Confirm the account, Worker, environment, deployed version, and affected workload before capturing a profile.
Check the current Cloudflare guide for supported CPU profiling and inspect installed cf command help.
Capture the profile, then analyze function-level evidence before proposing changes.

output_examples.input: My supplied profile shows generated JavaScript filenames instead of original source locations.
output: Original source attribution is limited by the available mappings.
Enable source maps and capture another profile to improve source attribution.
Report available function names and metrics without inventing original source locations.

best_practices: Confirm the exact deployment and Durable Object identity with the user before capture.
Use current documentation and installed CLI help to verify supported profiling options.
Tie each optimization to captured evidence and check its effect under a comparable workload.
anti_patterns: Capture profiles before confirming the correct account, environment, and deployed version.
Invent source locations or metric meanings when symbols or mappings are missing.
Make broad code changes without profile evidence or a plan to check their effects.

faq.question: What systems does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers profiling deployed Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects for CPU usage and memory allocation issues.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Capture still depends on deployment access and external tooling.

faq.question: Does the skill include a profiler?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow instructions and points to Cloudflare profiling APIs, the cf CLI, and tools such as Go's pprof.

faq.question: What happens if cf is not installed?
faq.answer: The skill suggests asking whether the user wants to install it. It does not provide an automatic installation command.

faq.question: Can it identify original source locations?
faq.answer: Only when evidence supports attribution. It reports missing symbols or mappings and suggests source maps when profiles reference generated JavaScript.

faq.question: Does it guarantee improved performance?
faq.answer: No. It proposes changes supported by the capture and explains how to check their effects.
